app.title: DnD Battlemap
app.subtitle: Offline battle maps for D&D 5e
nav.label: Main navigation
start.heading: No map open
start.intro: Build maps from elements, import your own images, place creatures and show areas of effect square by square – entirely without internet.
start.status: Version 0.1.0 – all specified features are implemented. New here? Try the examples below.
start.offline: This application makes no network connections.
toolbar.label: Toolbar
canvas.label: Map view. Arrow keys move the focus square, Enter applies the tool, Shift+arrow keys pan the view.
ruler.hintMouse: Drag to measure · Space: waypoint · Esc: clear
ruler.hintKeyboard: Enter: start/waypoint · Arrow keys: move · Esc: finish
props.heading: Map properties
props.name: Name
newMap.heading: New map
confirm.title: Unsaved changes
confirm.discard: The current map has unsaved changes. Discard changes?
confirm.closeUnsaved: Unsaved changes will be lost. Quit anyway?
recovery.heading: Unsaved map found
recovery.text: “{name}” was saved automatically on {time} but never saved to a file – for example after a crash.
recovery.discardConfirm: The automatically saved map “{name}” will be discarded permanently. Continue?
error.notZip: The file is not a valid map (.dndmap).
error.missingMapJson: The file contains no map data (map.json missing).
error.wrongFormat: The file is not a DnD Battlemap map.
error.newerVersion: The map was created by a newer version. Please update the app.
error.missingMigration: This file version cannot be converted.
error.io: The file could not be read or written.
shortcut.panDrag: Drag view (middle/right mouse button or Space + drag)
settings.heading: Settings
settings.showMeters: Also show distances in meters (5 ft = 1.5 m)
about.heading: About/Licenses
about.srd.heading: Rules content (SRD 5.1)
about.srd.note: Only content from the System Reference Document 5.1 is bundled. No other Wizards of the Coast content or artwork.
about.assets.heading: Graphics
about.assets.text: All graphics (icons, tiles, default tokens) are self-made (SVG/procedural) and part of this project.
about.thirdParty.heading: Third-party software
about.thirdParty.noText: No license text included in the package.
library.heading: Elements
import.heading: Import custom element
import.badType: Only PNG, SVG, WebP or JPG are supported.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
import.badContent: The file content does not match its extension or is not an image.
align.heading: Align
layers.heading: Layers
layers.name: Layer
terrain.heading: Terrain
terrain.hint: Apply with brush, rectangle, line or fill; the eraser removes painted terrain. Elements bring their own defaults (e.g. walls block).
note.heading: GM note – square {x}, {y}
note.hint: Visible to the GM only. Ctrl+Enter saves.
generator.heading: Insert template or random dungeon
generator.tooBig: The template is larger than the map. Enlarge the map or choose a smaller size.
generator.replace: Replace existing content in the area
notice.fillObjects: Fill only works with floors or terrain.
notice.outside: That does not fit on the map.
notice.chooseElement: Please choose an element on the left first.
hint.select: Click: select (tokens first) · Shift: add · Drag: move (tokens with path preview and cost) or draw a selection box · Arrow keys: move selection
hint.brush: Drag to paint · Q rotates the element
hint.shape: Drag from corner to corner · keyboard: Enter at start and end
hint.fill: Click fills connected squares with the same floor
hint.erase: Drag removes content of the active layer (or terrain)
hint.note: Click a square to write or edit a GM note
imageImport.filterName: Map images (JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF)
imageImport.badType: Only JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF can be imported as a map.
imageImport.tooLarge: The image file is larger than 200 MB.
imageImport.badContent: The file content does not match its extension or is not an image.
imageImport.tooManyPixels: The image is too large (at most 16384 pixels per side).
imageImport.decodeFailed: The image could not be decoded.
imageImport.dropHint: Drop a map image or .dndmap file here
calibrate.headingNew: New map from image – calibrate grid
calibrate.heading: Calibrate background image
calibrate.canvasLabel: Image preview. Drag or arrow keys move the grid (Shift: 10 px), wheel or +/− zooms, 0 fits, right mouse button pans.
calibrate.hintMove: Drag: move grid · Wheel: zoom · Right button: pan · yellow = square 1, 1
calibrate.hintPoints: Click two points on grid lines or intersections, then enter the number of squares between them
calibrate.halveHint: Halve the square size (one map square covers four image squares)
calibrate.detected: Detected: {px} px per square (clarity {percent} %). Please check.
calibrate.detectNone: No grid detected – please set the square size manually or with two points.
calibrate.pointsInvalid: The points are too close or the number of squares is invalid.
calibrate.tooManyCells: More than 200 squares – the map is limited to 200 and the rest of the image is hidden. Check crop or square size.
calibrate.fewCells: Fewer than 10 squares – maps have at least 10 × 10 squares; outside the image they stay empty.
calibrate.fitGrid: Fit map size to the image
hint.wall: Click sets corner points (chain) · Double-click, right button or Esc ends · keyboard: Enter at the top-left square corner
creatures.sourceNote: SRD stat blocks in the English original (SRD 5.1, CC-BY-4.0). Custom creatures and characters are stored locally.
creatures.libraryError: The library could not be read: {error}
pc.heading: Edit character
pc.name: Name
pc.imageTooLarge: The image is too large (at most about 2 MB).
pc.imageBadType: Only PNG, JPG or WebP can be used as a token image.
hb.heading: Edit custom creature
token.heading: Tokens
token.none: {count} token(s) on the map. Select a token to edit it.
token.name: Name
token.placeHint: Click a square to place {count}× “{name}” (Esc cancels).
notice.noSpace: No free space for the token.
notice.tokensPartial: Only {placed} of {count} tokens fit on the map.
notice.noPath: No regular path – token was moved without movement cost.
shortcut.tokenMove: Move selected token one square (with movement cost)
about.srd.data: SRD data (creatures, conditions, spells, magic items): machine-readable from 5e-bits/5e-database (MIT license), revision {commit}. Content: System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under CC-BY-4.0.
hint.effect: Choose an effect (left “Effects”) · Click: set origin or trigger · directional shapes: pointer sets the direction, second click triggers · Q rotates · Esc cancels
coverage.half: Square affected if at least half covered (default)
coverage.center: Square affected if its center is inside the area
trigger.both: On entering and at start of round
effect.name: Name
effect.hintDirection: Pointer sets the direction · click or Enter triggers · Esc resets the origin
effect.hint.sphere: Click a grid intersection (or per snap) to trigger.
effect.hint.cylinder: Click a grid intersection (or per snap) to trigger.
effect.hint.cone: First click: origin (e.g. caster’s edge), then choose a direction and click again.
effect.hint.cube: First click: center of a cube face, then choose a direction and click again.
effect.hint.line: First click: start point, then choose a direction and click again.
effect.hint.emanation: Click a token: the emanation follows it. Click an empty square: fixed emanation.
effect.hint.free: Click or drag over squares (click again to remove), then “Use area”.
effect.freeNotInLibrary: Free areas cannot be stored in the library – paint them directly on the map.
effect.sourceNote: SRD effects in the original wording (SRD 5.1, CC-BY-4.0); breath weapons from creature stat blocks.
notice.chooseEffect: First choose an effect or basic shape under “Effects” on the left.
assist.heading: Saving throws: {name}
assist.pending: Roll or enter a saving throw for all selected targets.
token.roundsViaCombat: During combat, rounds advance via the initiative tracker.
combat.heading: Combat
combat.intro: Select tokens (or none for all living ones) and start combat. Then roll or enter initiative.
combat.endConfirm: End combat? The order is discarded; the combat log is kept.
tie.players: Player characters first, then bonus, then random
dice.heading: Dice
attack.heading: Attack: {name}
log.heading: Combat log ({count})
log.more: … and {count} older entries (included in the export)
log.attackCrit: {attacker} critically hits {target} with {weapon}: {total} [{rolls}] vs AC {ac}, {damage} damage.
notice.nobodyCanAct: Nobody can act (all delayed or dead).
hint.fog: Fog: click/drag reveals or hides (mode and shape on the right) · Polygon: click corners, first corner or double-click closes · Esc cancels
hint.light: Light: click places the chosen light source; click a token to attach it (it moves along)
vision.heading: Vision, light and fog
vision.viewersHint: Players see what their characters (side “Player”, conscious, not blinded) see – including darkvision. Explored areas remain visible but dimmed.
fog.hint.rect: Drag a rectangle (keyboard: Enter at two corners).
fog.hint.polygon: Click corners on grid intersections; first corner or double-click closes.
fog.disabledHint: Fog is off – changes take effect once it is enabled.
light.hint: Click the map to place the source (square center); click a token to attach it.
player.title: Player view
player.waiting: Waiting for the map from the main window …
player.calibrateHint: Enter the screen diagonal; the square below must measure exactly 1 inch (2.54 cm) with a ruler – otherwise adjust the fine correction. The setting applies to this screen.
portrait.creatureHint: Applies to newly placed tokens of this creature.
libTransfer.heading: Share library
libTransfer.intro: Export characters, custom creatures, custom effects and creature images as a JSON file, or import such a file (e.g. another GM's homebrew).
libTransfer.empty: The library has no entries of the selected kinds.
libTransfer.nothing: The file contains no valid entries ({skipped} skipped).
libTransfer.overwrite: {count} entries already exist and would be replaced ({names} …). Continue?
libTransfer.bad.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
libTransfer.bad.wrongFormat: The file is not a DnD Battlemap library.
libTransfer.bad.newerVersion: The library comes from a newer program version.
libTransfer.bad.tooLarge: The file is too large (200 MB max).
keymap.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
keymap.intro: Reassign the single keys of the map view. Ctrl combinations (save, undo, copy …), arrow keys, Enter, Esc and Space are fixed.
keymap.reserved: The key “{key}” is reserved and cannot be used.
keymap.displaced: “{key}” was assigned to “{command}” – it has been removed there.
keymap.ping: Ping at mouse pointer / focus cell
hint.draw: Drag to draw an arrow, circle or freehand line (temporary, also shown in the player view). Keyboard: Enter starts, arrow keys guide, Enter ends. P pings.
draw.note: Drawings and pings are temporary: not saved, not in the undo history; the player view shows them too.
export.heading: Export map
export.audience.gm: GM version (with notes and hidden items)
export.pngLimited: Limited to {max} pixels per square (largest possible image).
export.mode.scale: 1 square = 1 inch, multiple pages to assemble
export.pagesScale: {count} pages ({across} × {down}), whole squares per page, with tile labels and crop marks. Print at “Actual size” (100 %).
export.pagesFit: One page, orientation by aspect ratio.
campaign.intro: A campaign bundles several maps (scenes) with links, notes, encounters and handouts in one file (.dndcampaign).
campaign.name: Campaign name
campaign.startHint: An empty first scene is created.
campaign.startHintMap: The open map becomes the first scene.
campaign.removeSceneConfirm: Remove scene “{name}” and its map from the campaign? Links to it are deleted.
campaign.linkHint: Choose a focus cell on the map (arrow keys or click), e.g. a door or stairs. Linked cells are marked in gold (GM only).
campaign.linkNeedsCell: Choose a focus cell on the map first.
campaign.handoutBadImage: The image is invalid or larger than 20 MB.
campaign.damagedScenes: These scenes could not be read and are missing: {names}
encounter.heading: Plan encounter
encounter.name: Name
encounter.summary: {total} XP total · adjusted {adjusted} XP (× {multiplier}) · {per} XP per character
encounter.dmgNote: Thresholds and multipliers from the Dungeon Master's Guide (2014) – not part of SRD 5.1. Only enemies count.
encounter.placed: {count} tokens placed (from the focus cell or the map center).
encounter.noSpace: No free space for the creatures.
snapshot.heading: Snapshots ({count})
snapshot.intro: Save the current state (tokens, combat, effects, fog …) and restore it later – e.g. “before combat” or to pause a fight. Saved with the map.
snapshot.name: Snapshot name
snapshot.full: At most {max} snapshots – please delete old ones.
snapshot.restoreConfirm: Reset the map to “{name}”? This can be undone; the combat log is kept.
snapshot.same: The map already matches this state.
examples.heading: Examples
examples.intro: Bundled examples to try out – changes are only kept when you save under your own name.
examples.taverneDesc: Built map with a party of heroes, guests and a GM note.
examples.gruftDesc: Dungeon with fog of war, darkness, a torch and undead – for trying out the player view.
examples.kampagne: Campaign: The Crypt beneath the Tavern
examples.kampagneDesc: Three scenes with links, a saved encounter, a handout and notes.
examples.leistungstestDesc: Large map with 150 tokens and 25 light sources.
crash.heading: An unexpected error occurred
crash.text: Part of the interface could not be displayed. This should not happen – please note what you did last.
crash.saved: Your unsaved changes were written to the recovery file; they will be offered on the next start.
crash.notice: Unexpected error – the action may not have been carried out.
settings.showPerformance: Show performance in the status bar (frame time)
status.perf: Frame {avg} ms (95 %: {p95} ms) · up to {fps} fps
status.perfHint: Time to build one frame (CPU, without waiting for the display). Below 16.7 ms is enough for 60 frames per second.
shortcut.quickSearch: Quick search: find and arm an effect
quickSearch.heading: Find effect
quickSearch.placeholder: Effect, damage type or kind – e.g. “fireball 5”, “fire”, “trap”
quickSearch.hint: Arrow keys select, Enter arms, Esc closes. A number at the end picks the spell level.
quickSearch.armed: “{name}” armed – choose the origin on the map.
quickSearch.armedSlot: “{name}” (level {slot}) armed – choose the origin on the map.
